references.rationale: Signer judged both 'falls since June' and prior left MCA infarct to deserve A/P representation, but on different encounter-role tiers: falls are PRIMARY/current; the prior infarct is BACKGROUND unless independently evaluated/managed. Background status does not eliminate its compact A/P representation.

Signer established the source-state rule: prior documentation supports historical established stroke and residual weakness, while the current encounter supports adoption of the falls problem. Historical presence alone does not create a newly adopted current-encounter claim or a causal relation. Thus the clean S2 adoption distinctions are clinically valid.
